findings.title: [SEC] gitleaks not installed (secret scan skipped)
findings.detail: Install gitleaks in CI to enable the secret scan.
findings.note: CI pins gitleaks 8.30.1 with SHA-256 verification (secret-history-scan.yml:27-39); the local machine check still emits this row because the audit host has no gitleaks binary (environmental, not a repo gap).

findings.title: [SUPPLY] 3 container image(s) without a digest pin
findings.detail: Pin images by digest (`image@sha256:...`) for reproducible, tamper-evident deploys.
findings.note: third-party-image-scan.yml fails on any unpinned literal image ref in infra/digitalocean/docker-compose.yml; the three mct-* refs are the repo's own images (built, scanned, attested; the deploy resolves digests) and are the documented exception.
